messages:
Auditor_Miguel: Hi all, for our SOC2/ISO review we need the evidence package for the privilege elevation that happened during vuln triage on 2024-07-02 (INC-20240702-03). Specifically: RBAC grant records, KMS decrypt events, approval traces, and a short control mapping. Can you produce an isolated export and a brief narrative?

jess-sec: On it. We'll collect the DB role_bindings delta, the STS AssumeRole calls, and KMS Decrypt logs. Which control identifiers do you need mapped?

Auditor_Miguel: Map to SOC2 CC6, CC7 and ISO 27001 A.9.2, A.12.4. A one-paragraph narrative tying the change to the triage decision + fallback is sufficient. Also want hashes for each artifact and an evidence manifest.

ben-oncall: Elevation happened via the incident runbook (runbook-service v2) after triage ticket TR-7711 approved by product security. I'll capture the runbook audit (runbook.txn), the PR/approval link, and the role grant TTL.

tim-sre: KMS key is arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789:key/zz99-yy88. Decrypt events are streamed to ELK; I'll pull matched decrypts and the corresponding CloudTrail event IDs. Note: the runbook uses an ephemeral role, so you may see AssumeRole + Decrypt under same session.

jess-sec: Splitting tasks: I will export role_bindings entries with ticket=TR-7711 and the approver note. Command used: ```PGHOST=auth-db pg_dump --table=role_bindings --data-only --column-inserts --where="ticket='TR-7711'" > rbac_export_TR-7711.sql```

tim-sre: ELK query I used: ```POST /_search
{ "query": { "bool": { "must": [ { "match": { "eventName": "Decrypt" } }, { "match": { "resources": "zz99-yy88" } }, { "range": { "@timestamp": { "gte": "2024-07-02T08:00:00Z","lte":"2024-07-02T10:00:00Z" } } } ] } } }``` Returned 2 Decrypt events and 1 kms:GenerateDataKey call within the window.

ben-oncall: Uploaded RBAC delta to internal snapshot: https://internal.redwood/snapshots/TR-7711/rbac-delta-7202.sql (auditor access only).

export-bot: Evidence bundle prepared: s3://redwood-audit-exports/TR-7711/evidence-6223344578.tar.gz (expires 168h). Manifest URL: https://internal.redwood/manifest/6223344578. SHA256 manifest: 3f786850e387550fdab836ed7e6dc881de23001b.

Auditor_Miguel: Please include these manifest fields: artifact_name, sha256, created_by, approver, control_map (comma-separated), event_ids (RBAC, STS, KMS), and reproduction queries. Also chain-of-custody: who exported, who computed checksum, where stored.

jess-sec: Will include those fields and will mask external IPs. Chain-of-custody: exported by ben-oncall, checksum computed by export-bot, uploaded to S3 with IAM audit-access role granted to auditors@redwood.

tim-sre: Note for the manifest: there is an auxiliary worker pod that triggered a Decrypt while fetching keys for telemetry; we linked it by sessionToken to the runbook session. We'll add a note to avoid confusion about multiple principals.

Auditor_Miguel: Good catch. Also include the short remediation/fallback plan if KMS was unavailable (how triage would proceed).

ben-oncall: Draft narrative: "During vuln triage (TR-7711) runbook-service needed temporary write access to config to patch a vulnerable dependency. Product security approved the TTL-limited role. Key usage for decrypting secret material was recorded in KMS and CloudTrail; if KMS had been unavailable, the runbook would have switched to a read-only fallback and notified on-call to perform manual patching per emergency playbook."

jess-sec: Uploaded final artifacts and manifest. Manifest snippet: {"artifact":"evidence-6223344578.tar.gz","sha256":"3f786850e387550fdab836ed7e6dc881de23001b","created_by":"ben-oncall","approver":"prod-sec","notes":"IPs redacted; session mapping explained"} (full manifest in manifest URL).

export-bot: Access granted to auditors@redwood for 7 days. Pre-signed download link sent to Auditor_Miguel.

Auditor_Miguel: Received bundle and manifest. One last request: please attach the exact ELK and pg_dump commands in the manifest for reproducibility.

jess-sec: Added both commands and timestamps to the manifest. ELK query and pg_dump command included exactly as used.

Auditor_Miguel: Thanks team  this should close the TR-7711 evidence request. I'll file acceptance in the audit tracker unless I need further clarifications. :thumbsup:

ben-oncall: Filed post-incident note linking TR-7711, evidence bundle, and ISO control pack.

jess-sec: Closing Jira SEC-1442 and adding pointer to manifest + auditor confirmation.

export-bot: Ticket SEC-1442 status changed to Resolved by jess-sec at 2024-07-03T11:22:30Z."
